message.content:
The value of $20 in British Pounds depends on the current USD/GBP exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day.  
As a rough estimate (using a recent mid‑market rate of about $1 ≈ £0.78), $20 would be roughly:

**$20 ≈ £15.60**

Keep in mind that the exact amount you receive can vary slightly depending on the exchange rate at the time of the transaction and any fees your bank or currency‑exchange service may charge. For the most accurate conversion, check a reliable financial news source or your banking app right before you make the exchange.
